document.text: from $events | fields user_id, asset_id | join left=e right=u where e.user_id=u.id [from $users | fields id] | join left=eu right=a where eu.asset_id=a.asset_key [from $assets | rename id AS asset_key | fields asset_key] | eval copied_id=user_id | fields copied_id
FROM $events AS e JOIN $users AS u ON e.user_id=u.id JOIN $assets AS a ON e.asset_id=a.id SELECT e.user_id AS user_id, u.id AS user_record, a.id AS asset_record
SELECT e.user_id AS user_id, u.id AS user_record, a.id AS asset_record FROM $events AS e LEFT JOIN $users AS u ON e.user_id=u.id LEFT OUTER JOIN $assets AS a ON e.asset_id=a.id
from $events | join left=e right=r where e.id=r.id [from $events]
from $events | join left=e right=r where e.id=r.id [from $events] | union [from $events]

from $events | rename id AS event_key | join left=e right=u where e.event_key=u.id [from $users | rename id AS user_key | eval id=user_key] | join left=eu right=a where eu.user_key=a.id [from $assets]
from $events | join left=e right=u where e.id=u.id [from $users] | fields id

$base = FROM $events | fields id;
$consumer = FROM $base | fields id;
from $events | join left=e right=u where e.payload.id=u.payload.id [from $users]

from $events | join left=e right=u where e.id= [from $users]
